hypothesis: Author (2026-11-19): the trace left by resource use changes the environment of later systems. AI translation for yeast on sucrose (C_L3_TRACE_YEAST): the shared glucose released by invertase is the trace, and the switch from slow to fast cooperative growth that Dai et al. (2012) fitted at N_c = 276 cells/ul happens when this shared glucose reaches G* = (1 - eps) h N_c / gamma_low = 1.56 mM (an upper estimate, since uptake before the switch is neglected). If so, yeast grown directly on glucose must reach Dai's fast rate gamma_high at a glucose concentration at or below about 1.6 mM.

observable.quantity: G_high: the lowest glucose concentration at which the measured per-capita growth rate reaches gamma_high - 1 sigma = 0.457 per hour, by linear interpolation in log10(glucose) between measured points
observable.domain: Gore, Youk and van Oudenaarden (2009) Nature 459, 253 (author manuscript PMC2888597): growth rate of S. cerevisiae against glucose concentration, the figure that reports it, digitised once after approval

prediction_method.description: G* from core/03_lanes/persistence/uet_layer3_trace_yeast.py (registered values only: Koschwanez et al. 2011 invertase kinetics; Dai et al. 2012 gamma_low and fitted N_c). G_high from the digitised Gore et al. (2009) growth-rate points: the first crossing of 0.457 per hour, linear in log10(glucose); digitisation uncertainty taken as half the axis tick spacing, propagated to an interval for G_high. Glucose in percent w/v converted with 180.16 g/mol. The capture efficiency eps is read from Gore et al. (2009) in the same session and replaces 0.01 if different.

fixed_parameters: G* = 1.56 mM computed before the comparison data are opened; recomputed only if Gore et al.'s printed eps differs from 0.01 (at most a few percent)
threshold growth rate 0.457 per hour (Dai et al. measured gamma_high 0.472 minus its 0.015 uncertainty)
lower plausibility bound G*/30 = 0.052 mM (AI choice: uptake can lower free glucose below the closed form, but a switch 30 times lower would mean the accumulated shared trace is not what triggers it)
no strain, medium or temperature correction between the two papers (both from the Gore lab, S. cerevisiae SUC2 background); stated as a limitation
pass_criterion: PASS if the whole digitisation interval of G_high lies within [G*/30, G*] = [0.052, 1.56] mM.
fail_criterion: FAILED if the whole interval of G_high lies above 3 G* = 4.7 mM or below G*/30 = 0.052 mM. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, including when the measured growth rate never reaches 0.457 per hour in the reported range or the interval straddles a boundary.
note: Disclosure: Dai et al. (2012) is SEEN (its fitted N_c is an input, not the outcome). The Gore et al. (2009) growth-rate figure has not been opened; the drafter recalls from general reading that Gore et al. fitted a concave power law to growth against glucose but does not recall the values. Strain, medium and temperature may differ between the two papers. The criteria (threshold 0.457 per hour, factor 3 above, factor 30 below) are AI choices for the author to accept or change before approval. Nearest theory: public-goods models of yeast cooperation (Gore et al. 2009) and Allee effects; a PASS shows the trace-feedback mapping is quantitatively consistent across two experiments, not a UET-distinct result. Approved by the author in chat on 2026-11-19 as drafted ("Approve and run"); this approval is committed before the comparison figure is opened. Label fix before the data were opened (same day, unpushed): the unseen Gore et al. data are a HOLDOUT, as the schema requires for a blind prediction; no criterion changed.
